title: Volunteer
summary: Share your time, skills and experience with young people who are eager to learn and grow.

detail.title: Volunteer With Us
detail.description: From mentoring and event support to media and logistics, there are many ways to serve.

steps.title: Register
steps.body: Fill in the form below. It takes about two minutes.

steps.title: We confirm
steps.body: Our Welfare & Logistics unit reviews and confirms you on the register.

steps.title: You are deployed
steps.body: When a duty matches your availability we contact you with the date, place and who to report to.

steps.title: On the day
steps.body: Your team lead checks you in. Some volunteers also work the gate, scanning tickets.

sections.title: Why volunteer with LCA?
sections.body: Volunteering with LCA is an opportunity to invest in the next generation while growing your own skills, network and sense of purpose. You will work alongside a committed team that values faith, excellence and service. Whether you can give a few hours at an event or commit to a longer programme, your contribution matters. We will help you find a role where you can serve confidently and make a real difference.
